title: Kids Schedule: snap the daycare calendar, get the whole month and reminders
description: Photograph the monthly calendar or newsletter from daycare or preschool. Every event lands in your calendar, with a reminder the evening before. Free.

hero.headline:
Snap the notice.
Pack the night before.
hero.lead: Take a photo of the monthly calendar your daycare sends home. Kids Schedule reads the dates, times and event names and adds them all at once. The evening before the field trip, at 8 p.m., you get a nudge to pack the lunch.
hero.cta: Get it free on the App Store
hero.note: Every feature is free. Your photos never leave your phone.

problem.title: Still copying the school newsletter into your calendar?
problem.text: Five or six events a month, each with something different to bring: a packed lunch, gym clothes, an apron. The schedule on the fridge is nowhere in sight on the way to work, and it always comes back to you the morning of. Kids Schedule turns that sheet of paper into calendar events and reminders.

features.title: One photo, one month
features.text:
Monthly grid, newsletter or one-off flyer: take a photo or pick one from your library and the dates, times and event names are read for you. You can also paste a text from the daycare, and words like "tomorrow" or "this Friday" become real dates.
Before saving, fix any title, date or note about what to bring, and swipe away what you don't need. Enter your child's class and events meant only for other classes are filtered out.

features.title: Reminded the evening before
features.text:
Pick from 8 p.m. the evening before, 7:30 a.m. the morning of, 1 hour before or right on time. Your note about what to bring shows up in the reminder, so the bag gets packed.
Turn on Apple Calendar and events go into a calendar named after your child, never added twice.

features.title: Several kids, the whole family
features.text:
Each child gets their own color. Switch between everyone at once and one child at a time, and Kids Schedule uses past events to guess whose notice you just scanned.
Send an invite link and your partner, grandparents or caregiver can see and edit the same events. A Home Screen widget shows what's coming up.

items.a: Monthly calendars (grids), newsletters written as sentences, and single notices or flyers. Shooting straight on so the text is sharp helps a lot, and you can pick several photos to scan at once.

items.q: Some events are missing or a title has a typo.
items.a: Handwriting and faint print can be hard to read. Fix the title, date or what to bring right in the list, or swipe away anything you don't need. Add a missing event with Add Event Manually on the Scan tab, then save again.
Check that notifications are allowed in Settings > Notifications > Kids Schedule. In the app's settings (⚙️) you can also choose which reminders you get.

items.q: Events for other classes show up too.
items.a: Enter your child's class name in Settings, and events meant only for other classes are filtered out. When your child moves up a year, just change it there.

items.q: I have more than one child.
items.a: Add as many children as you like in Settings, each with a profile photo. Choose whose events you're scanning, and the calendar shows each child in their own color, with a combined view and a filter per child.

items.q: How do I share the schedule with my partner?
items.a: In Settings, under Schedule Sharing, tap Invite People and send the link by message. They can see and edit every child and event, and changes from either side show up on both right away. This is separate from Apple Family Sharing.

items.q: Are there other ways to share?
items.a: The share button on the Calendar tab sends a Kids Schedule file, a calendar file (.ics) or a text summary. With Also add to Apple Calendar on, a calendar named after your child is created, and sharing it over iCloud in the Calendar app keeps your family in sync too.

items.q: Are my photos or events sent anywhere?
items.a: No. Text in your photos is read entirely on your device, and data is stored only on your device. Events go through your iCloud only when you invite someone with Schedule Sharing, and only to the people you invited.
